## Setup

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(tidyverse)
library(SeuratObject)
library(scCustomize)
library(presto)
library(pheatmap)

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v2")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "murine-cart-tumor")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# Source function
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "run_doubletfinder.R"))
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "run_soupx.R"))

# set random seed
set.seed(1234)
```

## Load Cell Ranger data and merge
```{r load-data}
# All 14 sample names and conditions
samples <- c("Tumor_only_D1", "Tumor_only_D2", "STOP_pos_T_D1", "STOP_pos_T_D2",
             "B7H3_pos_T_D1", "B7H3_pos_T_D2",
             "41BB-L_pos_T_D1", "41BB-L_pos_T_D2", 
             "CD8-41BB_pos_T_D1", "CD8-41BB_pos_T_D2",
             "CD28-41BB_pos_T_D1", "CD28-41BB_pos_T_D2")

objs <- lapply(samples, function(s) {
  counts <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(data_dir, s, "filtered_bc"))
  CreateSeuratObject(counts, project = s)
})

combined <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y), objs)
combined <- JoinLayers(combined)
```


## Define myeloid core + lineage marker lists
```{r define-marker-lists}
# T cells
tcell_genes <- c(
  "Cd3d","Cd3e","Cd3g","Cd247",
  "Trac","Trbc1","Trbc2",
  "Il7r","Ccr7","Tcf7","Lef1",
  "Cd4","Cd8a","Cd8b1"
)

# B cells
bcell_genes <- c("Ms4a1","Cd79a","Cd79b","Cd74","Bank1","Cd22","Cd19", "Mzb1")

# Hard-core myeloid (safe for SoupX)
myeloid_hard <- c(
  "Lyz2","Lyz1",
  "C1qa","C1qb","C1qc",
  "Lst1","Tyrobp","Aif1",
  "Csf1r","Ctss","Ctsd","Ctsb","Laptm5",
  "Ms4a7","Fcgr3","S100a8","S100a9",
  "P2ry12","Trem2","Gpr34","Spi1"
)

# TAM/lipid/MHCII (note for SoupX)
soft_tam_genes <- c(
  "Apoe","Apoc1","Fabp5","Lgals3","Spp1","Lpl",
  "H2-Aa","H2-Ab1","H2-Eb1","Cd74"
)

# Astrocytes
astro_genes <- c("Gfap","Aqp4","Aldh1l1","Slc1a3")

# Neurons
neuron_genes <- c("Snap25","Rbfox3","Syt1","Grin1","Nefl")

# Oligodendrocytes
oligo_genes <- c("Mbp","Plp1","Mog","Mobp","Sox10")

# Endothelial cells
endo_genes <- c("Pecam1","Eng","Kdr","Esam","Rgs5","Cdh5","Cldn5","Vwf")

# Fibroblasts
fibro_genes <- c("Pdgfra","Pdgfrb","Col1a1","Col1a2","Dcn","Lum")
```

## Basic QC
```{r basic-qc}
# Calculate percent mito
combined[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(combined, pattern = "^mt-")
combined <- subset(
  combined,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > 50 &
           nCount_RNA > 100 &
           percent.mito < 10
)
```

## Normalize + module scores
```{r module-scores, warning=FALSE}
combined <- NormalizeData(combined)

combined <- AddModuleScore(combined, list(Tc=tcell_genes),      name="Tscore")
combined <- AddModuleScore(combined, list(Bc=bcell_genes),      name="Bscore")
combined <- AddModuleScore(combined, list(My=myeloid_hard), name="Myeloid")
combined <- AddModuleScore(combined, list(As=astro_genes),      name="Astro")
combined <- AddModuleScore(combined, list(Ne=neuron_genes),     name="Neuron")
combined <- AddModuleScore(combined, list(Ol=oligo_genes),      name="Oligo")
combined <- AddModuleScore(combined, list(Et=endo_genes),       name="Endo")
combined <- AddModuleScore(combined, list(Fb=fibro_genes),      name="Fibro")
```

## HVGs + coarse clustering
```{r hvg-clustering}
combined <- FindVariableFeatures(combined, nfeatures = 3000)
combined <- ScaleData(combined, features = VariableFeatures(combined))
combined <- RunPCA(combined, features = VariableFeatures(combined))
combined <- FindNeighbors(combined, dims = 1:30)
combined <- FindClusters(combined, resolution = 0.5)
combined <- RunUMAP(combined, dims = 1:30)
```

## Examine module scores
```{r visualize-module-scores, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
DimPlot(combined, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE) + NoLegend()

for (score in c("Tscore1", "Bscore1", "Myeloid1", "Astro1", "Neuron1", "Oligo1", "Endo1", "Fibro1")) {
  p <- FeaturePlot(combined, features = score) + 
    scale_color_viridis_c() + 
    ggtitle(paste0("Module Score: ", score))
  print(p)
}
```

## Assign coarse cell types per cluster
```{r assign-coarse-celltypes}
Idents(combined) <- combined$seurat_clusters

cluster_scores <- FetchData(
  combined,
  vars = c("Tscore1", "Bscore1", "Myeloid1", "Astro1", "Neuron1", "Oligo1", "Endo1", "Fibro1", "seurat_clusters"
)) %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(
    Tscore = mean(Tscore1),
    Bscore = mean(Bscore1),
    Myeloid = mean(Myeloid1),
    Astro = mean(Astro1),
    Neuron = mean(Neuron1),
    Oligo = mean(Oligo1),
    Endo = mean(Endo1),
    Fibro = mean(Fibro1),
    n_cells = n()
  )

# heatmap of cluster X module score
pheatmap(
  as.data.frame(cluster_scores %>% select(-n_cells)) %>% column_to_rownames("seurat_clusters"),
  scale = "row",
  cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F,
  main = "Cluster Module Scores"
)

# Manually assign coarse cell types based on module scores
coarse_celltypes <- c(
  "0"="Myeloid",
  "1"="Myeloid",
  "2"="T",
  "3"="Myeloid",
  "4"="Myeloid",
  "5"="Endo",
  "6"="Neuron",
  "7"="B",
  "8"="Myeloid",
  "9"="Fibro",
  "10"="Myeloid",
  "11"="Myeloid",
  "12"="B",
  "13"="Myeloid",
  "14"="B",
  "15"="Fibro",
  "16"="Oligo",
  "17"="Astro",
  "18"="Myeloid",
  "19"="Astro",
  "20"="Astro",
  "21"="Fibro",
  "22"="Myeloid",
  "23"="Endo"
)

combined$coarse_celltype <- plyr::mapvalues(
  x = as.character(combined$seurat_clusters),
  from = names(coarse_celltypes),
  to = coarse_celltypes
)
```

## Visualize coarse cell types
```{r visualize-coarse-celltypes}
DimPlot(combined, group.by = "coarse_celltype", label = TRUE) + NoLegend()
```
